project.title: Essentials of HUD Program - Navigating EIV
project.description: In this class, you’ll learn about the Enterprise Income Verification system (EIV) used for HUD-subsidized properties. The covered topics are pulled from HUD Handbook 4350.3 and include where EIV data originates, how to safely store the reports, and the purpose for each of the 11 reports: when they are run, how long they are kept and in which files. Additional issues include data correction, repayment of assistance and fraud. At the end of the class, you’ll receive a certificate of attendance, including one hour of continuing education.
